sections.title: Messages on your phone
items: Tap Latest in the Messages header to reach the newest COS reply.
On the folded Duo, tap the pencil above Back to reopen a collapsed reply box.
Use the handle above the reply box to give more room to the conversation.

sections.title: Phone approvals and Sessions
items: After COS confirms a verified message was sent or queued, it returns to the original chat.
Pair this Mac release with server 7.0.66 for phone enrollment and approval-key management.
Try interactive checklists with experimental result cards enabled.
The setup Permissions badge refreshes when you return from System Settings.

notice.title: If an update says Download timed out
notice.body: COS Control 0.5.318 and earlier give an update about two minutes to download, and the update is now about 1.5 GB. If Install says Download timed out, or Downloading does not finish, go to gotcos.com/control/#unstuck. Download COS Control there, unzip it and move it into Applications, replacing the old copy. Or press Unstuck to have your AI app do it for you, after it checks nothing is recording. COS Control 0.5.319 and earlier can also stall on Installing: Force Quit COS Control (Option-Command-Escape) within a minute, and the update installs and reopens. Your meetings and the glasses server are not affected. From 0.5.320 on, updates download and install by themselves.
